leaves.container_start: Container launch to the first engine log line: Docker start and Python/engine imports. Needs --launch-time.
leaves.config_and_arch: Argument parsing, model config and architecture resolution, tokenizer and multimodal setup in the API process.
leaves.engine_spawn: Spawning the engine core process, up to the first distributed-init line.
leaves.worker_init: Starting the tensor-parallel workers and initializing distributed communication, up to the last rank reporting in.
leaves.pre_load: Model construction and setup before weights start moving (empty modules, backend selection).
leaves.weight_loading: Reading the checkpoint and placing weights in GPU memory, as reported by the engine (slowest rank).
leaves.post_load: Work after weights are loaded and before profiling: post-processing, quantization setup, memory accounting.
leaves.compile_setup: Preparation before the Dynamo transform (cache lookup, encoder profiling).
leaves.dynamo_transform: TorchDynamo bytecode transform, as reported by the engine.
leaves.compile_backend: torch.compile backend compilation after the Dynamo transform (Inductor and cache save).
leaves.initial_profile_run: The first profiling forward pass, as reported by the engine.
leaves.graph_memory_profiling: Measuring how much GPU memory CUDA graph capture will need, before the KV cache is sized (vLLM 0.18 and later), up to the engine's estimate.
leaves.profile_and_jit: Profiling forward passes and JIT kernel compilation (Triton, TileLang) that run before or between graph captures.
leaves.kv_sizing: Sizing and allocating the KV cache after profiling.
leaves.graph_capture: CUDA graph capture, summed over all passes, as reported by the engine.
leaves.deepgemm_warmup: DeepGEMM kernel warmup over all registered shapes.
leaves.final_warmup: Remaining engine warmup between KV cache sizing and engine ready.
leaves.app_construction: Building the HTTP application and routes after the engine is ready.
leaves.server_startup: HTTP server startup, up to the ready line.

checks.description: Phases from the end of from_phase to the end of to_phase must sum to the engine's own 'init engine ... took' figure.
